title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

title: Jai Santoshi Maa
desc: Mahima marries Anuraag and endures hostility from her in-laws. With faith and love, she works to win them over and create a peaceful, happy home together for all.

title: Ram Lakhan
desc: Ram, a righteous cop, and Lakhan, his carefree brother, unite for revenge after discovering their father was murdered by two cunning criminals. Justice, drama, and brotherhood drive their journey.

title: Sanam Teri Kasam
desc: When Saraswati is thrown out by her father, Inder stands by her through every hardship, bringing them closer. But just as love blooms, destiny intervenes with plans to tear them apart.

title: Dhamaal
desc: Roy, Manav, Aditya and Boman chase a hidden treasure in Goa, but as Inspector Kabir gets on their trail, their fun-filled adventure turns into a chaotic race against time.

title: Dunki
desc: A group of friends risk everything to reach the UK through a dangerous route called 'donkey flight', facing life-threatening challenges and the harsh reality of illegal immigration.

title: Udta Punjab
desc: A rock star, labourer, doctor, and cop struggle with a drug crisis in Punjab. Their lives intertwine as they fight addiction and chaos.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Naseeb
desc: Namdev, Raghu, Damu, and Jaggi win a lottery. Greed consumes Raghu and Damu, who murder Jaggi and frame Namdev. Returning later, Namdev seeks revenge against his betrayers.

title: Good Newwz
desc: Two couples with the same last name undergo IVF, eagerly awaiting their babies. Chaos erupts when they discover their sperm samples have been accidentally swapped.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
desc: An astrologer foretells a bright future for Raja, an idle young man, who falls for Shalu, a millionaire's daughter. Her father insists Raja must work hard and earn money to win her hand.

title: Dhadkan
desc: Anjali loves Dev, but family pressure forces her to marry Ram. Years later, Dev returns to win her back, only to find she has grown to love her husband.

title: Dil Dhadakne Do
desc: Kamal and Neelam celebrate their 30th anniversary on a cruise, where family, friends, and unexpected lessons transform their lives and relationships forever.

title: Singh Is King
desc: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
desc: A young woman, duped and sold to a brothel, rises above despair. Using underworld connections, she transforms from pawn to ruler, commanding power in a ruthless world.

title: Judgementall Hai Kya
desc: Bobby, a dubbing artist with a troubled past, rents part of her home to Keshav and Rima. But her dark memories return as she grows wary and starts spying on Keshav.
